sections.label: ComCare criteria and drop
sections.summary: The slight drop goes against revised criteria in which ComCare Assistance was tweaked and criteria went up.

sentences.speaker: Mr Seah Kian Peng (Marine Parade)
sentences.text: First, the slight drop, it goes against the revised criteria where the ComCare Assistance has been tweaked.

sentences.speaker: Mr Seah Kian Peng (Marine Parade)
sentences.text: In fact, the criteria have all gone up.

sections.label: ComCare trends and access
sections.summary: Numbers stabilised and decreased this year, though criteria changes such as student care increased recipients; SSO availability and the ComCare number are cited.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: If we look at the trends, there seem to be indications that because of the increase in accessibility and because of the nature that we work where it becomes pervasive, the numbers that we have seen, in fact, not only stabilised, but have decreased this year.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: And even though we made some changes to the criteria, nevertheless, there are areas whereby, because of the changes in the criteria, such as student care, the help that we give, there was an increase in the number of those who received help.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: With regard to the issues that the Member asked relating to weekends, again, the Member will realise that because of this SSO availability, and also we see more and more grassroots organisations able to reach out to residents better, and we also received residents calling our ComCare number 1800-222-0000, it is something that I want to encourage every Member here to memorise and see how we can facilitate the process, just give a call and see how we can help fellow Singaporeans.

sections.label: SSO help with documentation
sections.summary: Asks whether SSOs will help applicants who cannot bring documentation, via phone, mail, email or house visits.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: In the same vein, when we talk about making sure ComCare is available to everyone who needs it, will the SSOs work with applicants or potential applicants to overcome issues, like they are not able to go down and bring documentation, because that is usually one of the steps in the process that they have to go down to the SSOs with documentation.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: Some of them have to take leave from work to do so.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: So, would the SSOs try to overcome that by, for example, having a phone conversation and exchange of documents some other way, by mail or email, or will they consider even making house visits in certain cases where it is absolutely necessary?

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: Let us, say, in my area, if there are residents who have issues, who even cannot go to the SSO, my grassroots leaders and fellow residents will come and assist in the process.
